item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2988] Zeppelin does not start new Livy session if yarn livy session application is killed
item.description:
Scenario:
1) Create a livy notebook
2) run 2 paragraph ( Make sure a livy session yarn application is started )
3) Clone livy notebook
4) Kill yarn livy application
5) Run paragraphs from Clone livy notebook
Here, Cloned notebook para fails with "org.springframework.web.client.HttpServerErrorException: 500 Internal Server Error".
Zeppelin still try to connect to previous livy session which is killed. It does not start new session.

GitHub user zjffdu opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/2625

ZEPPELIN-2988. Zeppelin does not start new Livy session if yarn livy session application is killed

      1. What is this PR for?

This PR will display a warning message when the livy session is dead. It won't restart it automatically, because livy session may be dead due to user code (like driver OOM). Restarting it automatically will hide the root cause and confuse users.
